liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Smoke**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Sunday**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **I See America**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **(Smells Like) Teen Spirit**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **I See America (reprise)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Rocket Man**: rare: 12 archived performances [6]
- **Jordan**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Look Up**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]

## The recordings

- **mmj2022-08-21.schoepsMK5** (recommended): audience recording; 29 songs; 185 min [1]
- **mmj2022-08-21.mmj2022-08-21.dpa4061**: audience recording; 29 songs; 185 min [2]. Said about its sound: The uploader says it has a very different flavor from the other recordings of this show [2]
- **mmj2022-08-21.FLAC**: source not stated; 29 songs; 193 min [3]. Said about its sound: The uploader says it sounds very different from what was captured in the pit [3]
- **mmj2022-08-21**: audience recording; 19 songs; 140 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Johnny Quaid played guitar on the encore songs [1]
- The taper felt the whole night was an event, so everything recorded is included [1]
- Johnny Quaid played guitar on the encore songs [3]
- Johnny Quaid played guitar for the entire encore [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2022-08-21.schoepsMK5**: taped by jb63; transferred by jb63; source: AUD [1]. Also: Schoeps MK5 mics recorded to cards, then went through acmV3 and R44, Sound Studio and xACT to FLAC; taped up close in the pit [1]
- **mmj2022-08-21.mmj2022-08-21.dpa4061**: taped by jb63; transferred by jb63; source: Aud [2]. Also: DPA 4061 omni mics went through acmV3 and R44 to FLAC; taped in the pit, just left of center; It used the same R44 as the Schoeps tape, so the files sync exactly and can be combined as a 4-channel mix [2]
- **mmj2022-08-21.FLAC**: taped by jb63; transferred by jb63; source: dpa4021 —> acmV3 —> R44 [3]
- **mmj2022-08-21**: taped by opsopcopolis; transferred by opsopcopolis; source: AUD [4]. Also: Berliner CM33 mics into a Zoom F8, then ProTools and xACT, ending as FLAC [4]
